OpenDuckFrame 0.6.2

  • 在支持的 macOS 26 及更新系统中，首次使用或恢复默认配置时选择 Apple 低延迟 2 倍插帧；其他受支持设备使用 ODF-VFI fast X2，已有配置的引擎选择不变。
  • 窗口列表按应用分组，支持展开与键盘选择；需要屏幕录制权限时，刷新列表会引导授权，并在权限生效后重新获取窗口。
  • 有新版本可用时，工作台设置按钮旁显示下载入口。
  • 苹果视频超分复用有上限的缓冲区，减少重复分配；实际画质和流畅度仍取决于设备、片源与设置。
  • On supported macOS 26+ systems, new and reset default profiles select Apple low-latency interpolation at 2×. Other supported devices use ODF-VFI fast X2; saved engine choices are preserved.
  • The window list groups windows by app and supports keyboard navigation. Refresh guides Screen Recording permission and reloads the list when access becomes available.
  • A download control appears beside Settings when an update is available.
  • Apple video super resolution reuses bounded buffers to reduce repeated allocation. Actual quality and smoothness depend on the device, source and settings.

苹果插帧和超分需要受支持的系统、硬件和输入；缩小输入可能损失细节，增强也可能增加延迟。此社区版使用临时签名，未经过 Apple 公证，升级后可能需要重新授予屏幕录制或辅助功能权限。 Apple interpolation and super resolution require supported systems, hardware and input. Reducing input can lose detail, and enhancement may add latency. This ad-hoc-signed community build is not Apple notarized; macOS may ask for Screen Recording or Accessibility permission again after an upgrade.

OpenDuckFrame 0.5.0

  • 工作台新增 Apple 低延迟插帧与 Apple 帧率转换，ODF-VFI 仍为默认。苹果选项需要系统、硬件与输入格式支持。
  • 修复苹果低延迟处理大窗口时无法启动的问题，并调整生成帧的缓冲与呈现顺序。缩小处理可能使细节变软，缓冲会增加延迟。
  • 苹果低延迟实时增强可选“自动视频”，识别常见 24／25／30 FPS 并整理时间轴。默认仍是“通用窗口”；声音由来源应用播放，可能出现音画偏移。
  • Fast X2 窗口优化不再限定设备型号。按 GPU 能力、内存预算和准备耗时判断，预算充足保留原尺寸，不足时采用较低处理尺寸。
  • Adds Apple low-latency interpolation and Apple FRC alongside default ODF-VFI, subject to runtime system, hardware and input support.
  • Repairs large-window Apple low-latency activation and adjusts bounded buffering and frame order. Reduced inference can soften detail; buffering adds delay.
  • Adds optional Automatic video timing for common 24/25/30 FPS live content. General window remains the default; source audio may lead enhanced video.
  • Fast X2 window optimization now uses GPU capabilities, memory budgets and preparation timing instead of a device-model whitelist, preserving native size when its preparation budget fits.

实际画质和持续帧率仍取决于设备、输入与设置。Preparation timings do not establish sustained FPS. This community build is ad-hoc signed, supports signed in-app updates, and is not Apple notarized. macOS may ask for Screen Recording or Accessibility permission again after an upgrade. 此社区版未经过 Apple 公证，升级后可能需要重新授权。

OpenDuckFrame 0.4.1

  • 移除显示器来源的全屏预览选项，增强画面跟随来源；旧配置不会重新开启该预览。
  • 视频文件的全屏输出选项继续保留。
  • Removes the fullscreen preview option for display sources; output follows the source even when an older profile enabled that preview.
  • Keeps the fullscreen output option for video files.

This community build is ad-hoc signed and supports signed in-app updates. It is not Apple notarized. macOS may ask for Screen Recording or Accessibility permission again after an upgrade. 此社区版未经过 Apple 公证，升级后可能需要重新授权。
